integrity: The statement uses the housekeeper-inclusive exact envy-freeness definition in the cited 2024 publication. Complete classification and threshold have an elementary proof; finite exhaustive checks are corroborative only. Publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Positive integer agent budgets, distinct indivisible unit-size/unit-disutility chores, identical additive disutility and one housekeeper. The result does not extend to arbitrary heterogeneous weights or establish EF1/EFX counts. Source comparisons cannot rule out unindexed equivalences; no independent validation has been performed.
title: Sharp envy-free workload conductor and exact census for budgeted unit chores
